blocks.text: Getting started with Gmail for logistics planners on Mac

There is no native Gmail app for macOS. You access it through a browser like Safari or Chrome. For a better experience, turn your Gmail account into a web app. In Chrome, go to the three-dot menu, select Save and Share, then Install page as app. In Safari, use File > Add to Dock. This gives you a dedicated icon on your Mac dock. It keeps your inbox separate from your other browser tabs.

Speed is vital when you track dozens of shipments. Enable keyboard shortcuts in Settings > General > Keyboard shortcuts. Once enabled, press ? to see the full list. Use c to compose, e to archive, and r to reply. These small habits save minutes every hour. For logistics, focus on learning j and k to move through your email list without touching your trackpad.
Organizing your inbox with filters and labels

Your inbox likely fills with automated carrier notifications and urgent vendor updates. Use filters to keep this under control. Click the search bar settings icon, enter keywords like 'tracking' or 'BOL', and select Create filter. You can automatically apply a label like 'Shipment Updates' or 'Action Required'. This prevents your primary inbox from becoming a bottleneck.

blocks.text: Lazur helps you process information faster. Hold ⌥ ⌘ while looking at an email from a carrier. Ask Lazur to summarize the delivery status. It reads the screen and tells you the key details. If you need to write a reply, hold the fn key to dictate your response. Lazur ensures your dictation is formatted correctly before it hits the email body.
Common mistakes in logistics email management

Many planners keep too many tabs open. This slows down your Mac and makes it harder to focus. Use specific browser windows for email and logistics portals. Another mistake is ignoring the daily sending limit. If you send too many emails to multiple recipients, Google may block your account for 24 hours. Keep your recipient list clean and use BCC for large distributions.
Advanced tips for supply chain coordination

Create a label for every major client or project. This makes searching easier later. Use the Search bar with operators like 'has:attachment' or 'from:vendor@example.com'. Combine these with your labels to find specific documents in seconds. If you use third-party apps, ensure they support OAuth. Google no longer supports less secure apps that only use basic passwords.

Your Mac is a powerful tool for logistics. Use Split View to keep Gmail on one side and your TMS or spreadsheet on the other. Hover over the green full-screen button at the top left of any window to trigger this. This allows you to copy data from emails directly into your tracking sheets without switching windows constantly.

faq.question: Is there a native Gmail app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, Google does not provide a native desktop app for macOS. You should use a browser like Chrome or Safari and create a web app shortcut.

faq.question: How do I fix Gmail connectivity errors?
faq.answer: Check your internet connection first. If errors persist, clear your browser cache and cookies, or try opening Gmail in an incognito window to rule out extension conflicts.

faq.question: How many emails can I send per day?
faq.answer: Personal accounts can send to up to 500 recipients per day. Google Workspace accounts can send to up to 2,000 recipients daily.

faq.question: What should I do if my account is blocked?
faq.answer: If you exceed sending limits, your account may be blocked for 24 hours. You must wait for the block to expire before you can send emails again.
